lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn6V crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell containing 10 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows Mg and V each in octahedral environments with six Mn neighbors, while Mn centers adopt 7- and 10-vertex coordination environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Mg octahedra and Mn polyhedra, edge-sharing between Mg and V octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Mn polyhedra.
